definitions.gloss: reserved seating; seat reservation; seat designation
definitions.explanation: A system where specific seats are assigned in advance, as opposed to free seating.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{座席指定|ざせきしてい}です。
{座席指定|ざせきしてい}の{券|けん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a reserved seat ticket.

examples.japanese: {映画館|えいがかん}は{全席|ぜんせき}{座席指定|ざせきしてい}になっているので、{事前|じぜん}に{予約|よやく}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: The movie theater has all reserved seating, so it's better to book in advance.

notes:
{座席指定|ざせきしてい} means reserved seating as opposed to free seating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {座席指定|ざせきしてい}{券|けん} (reserved seat ticket)
- {全席|ぜんせき}{座席指定|ざせきしてい} (all seats reserved)
- {座席指定|ざせきしてい}{料金|りょうきん} (reserved seat fee)

USAGE:
- Common on shinkansen, limited express trains, concerts, movies
- Opposite of {自由席|じゆうせき} (non-reserved seating)

RELATED WORDS:
- {指定席|していせき}: reserved seat
- {自由席|じゆうせき}: non-reserved seat
